title: fagus sylvatica f. laciniata
intro: Fagus sylvatica f. laciniata, commonly known as Cut-leaved Beech, is a variety of the Fagus sylvatica tree that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This deciduous tree is valued for its unique cut or laciniated leaves, which are often used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Cut-leaved Beech include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of Cut-leaved Beech, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
